guide.title: Groq API Key Guide
guide.subtitle: Set up a free Groq API key to power AI text polishing in Rivertide.
guide.purposeTitle: What this key is used for
guide.purposeBody: Rivertide calls the Groq cloud API to polish your transcriptions - removing fillers, fixing repetitions, adding punctuation, and adjusting tone based on your rules.
guide.finalHint: Paste the key in Settings → Transcription → Groq.

1.title: Open the Groq Console
1.body: In your browser, go to console.groq.com. This is where you'll create your account and manage API keys.

2.title: Sign up or log in
2.body: Create a free account with Google, GitHub, SSO, or email. No credit card is required.

3.title: Go to API Keys
3.body: Click "API Keys" in the left sidebar. You can also jump straight to console.groq.com/keys.

4.title: Create an API key
4.body: Click "Create API key", give it a recognizable name (e.g. "Rivertide"), then click Create.

5.title: Copy the key
5.body: Your key appears once and starts with gsk_. Copy it right away - for security, Groq won't show it again.

6.title: Paste it into Rivertide
6.body: Open Settings → Transcription → Groq, paste the key into the API Key field, then click "Test Connection" to verify.

guide.securityLocal: Your key is stored locally on this device and is only sent to api.groq.com when Rivertide makes a request.
guide.securityLost: If you lose a key, delete it in the console and create a new one - you don't need to wait for anything.
guide.securityShare: Never share your key or commit it to source control. Anyone with it can spend your Groq quota.
